addr: Nexus Mall, Hosur Rd, Chikku Lakshmaiah Layout, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560030, India

rev.t:
“I didn’t get a taste of the ice cream. If the brand isn’t known, at least the flavor/taste should be mentioned.”
Service is very poor and the guy is not friendly, need to learn how to communicate with customers. The quality of ice cream is not worth for the price

The waffles were extremely disappointing. They lacked proper flavor and were nowhere near worth the price. The attractive presentation and display outside the shop create high expectations, but the quality of the waffles served falls far short. Overall, it was an underwhelming experience and definitely not value for money.

Most of the desserts here are good… you walk in excited. But the “Butterscotch Blast” in the sundae section? Sounds crunchy, nutty, full of layers.
NOPE. …
